name: kit
description: Bootstrap projects with blocks and Git hosting; verify features and manage secrets through a metadata-only broker.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap projects and install tested feature blocks
interface.longDescription: Create Worker, vinext or local Rust server projects with compatible blocks and optional Git hosting. Search, install and verify blocks with dry-run diffs. An operator-configured remote broker generates secrets and registers GitHub Actions or Worker sync access without returning values. Pstack is an optional separate dependency.
defaultPrompt: Use $kitbash-bootstrap to create a vinext project with cache blocks.
Use $kitbash-use to add email sign-in to this project.
Use $kitbash-use to find a block for rate limiting and install it.
Use $kitbash-harvest to turn this feature into a block.
Use $kitbash-harvest to prepare a reusable block contribution.
Use $kitbash-secrets to generate staging secrets through the configured broker.
